root_idea.summary: The root centers on blame and censure, the opposite of praise.
root_idea.development: From blame developed associated meanings of a covenant or protected right, since neglecting or violating it incurs blame. The root also preserves distinct usages for scanty wells and flowing or deposited matter.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested noun with the lexical meaning of covenant, protection, and inviolable obligation.
Quran-attested passive participle with a distinct blame or disgrace meaning.

senses.definition: A covenant or compact carrying an inviolable right or obligation, and the protection or security arising from it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quran for a protected covenant or undertaking whose violation entails blame; the two occurrences are in the expression ذِمَّةً.

senses.definition: Blamed, censured, or discredited; hence disgraced or regarded as not praiseworthy.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle of ذَمَّ. Quranic contextual renderings vary between being blamed and being disgraced, without requiring separate lexical senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame, censure, dispraise, or find fault with; also to satirize, especially in verse, or to suffer loss or diminution in reputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The core Form I verbal use; the satirical and reputational uses are associated extensions of blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a place: to become barren or affected by drought, with its produce becoming scanty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative use applied to land or its pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the nose: to flow with mucus or other nasal discharge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily use distinct from the blame verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass one’s life contending with or resigned to scantiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III expression describing endurance of a meagre condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do or say something for which one deserves blame or censure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV intransitive use; it may be construed with a person or people affected by the blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a riding camel or other mount: to become jaded, cease progressing, and lag behind the traveling company.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized Form IV use associated with failure to keep pace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find a person, place, or thing blameworthy, faulty, or discommendable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV use meaning to judge or discover something to be blameworthy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold someone in low or mean estimation or contempt, or to leave someone blamed among the people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The contempt sense occurs with بِهِ or بِهِمْ in the cited constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant protection, refuge, or security; to obtain a promise or covenant of safety for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form IV protective use includes securing another’s protection or taking responsibility for that security.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shun or avoid blame; to refrain from something out of disdain, shame, or fear of censure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can also mean being regardful of what deserves reverence, respect, honour, or defence in a companion or neighbour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame, censure, or find fault with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal Form VI use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To require or invite blame, or to be blamed or dispraised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X use expressing seeking or undergoing the state of blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beg or implore someone’s protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a post-classical expression and possibly an older Classical phrase; the attribution is therefore qualified.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a gift small, scanty, or insufficient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reduplicated or special-form usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blame, dispraise, or censure; in the plural, vices, faults, or defects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal and plural uses corresponding to the core blame branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excessively lean or emaciated; perishing or like one who is perishing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival or substantival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well containing little water; according to another reported usage, a well containing much water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two opposed descriptions are explicitly reported as variant meanings. This vowel pattern is distinct from ذِمَّةٌ, the covenant noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A binding right or due, responsibility, surety, or obligation for fulfilling an undertaking, repaying what is owed, or safeguarding a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical constructions extend the covenant sense to the moral or legal seat of obligation and to a due owed to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People placed under a covenant of protection, especially protected non-Muslim subjects who pay the jizyah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression formed from ذِمَّةٌ; the protected status includes security for life and property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A repast or banquet to which guests are invited, whether simply for food or for a wedding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blamed, dispraised, or disapproved; discommendable when applied to a person, a place of sojourning, or water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This adjectival synonym is kept distinct from the Quranic passive participle مَذْمُومٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mucus or another fluid discharge, including fluid issuing from the nose or from the penis of a male goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized bodily-fluid use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk that flows from the teats or becomes spread upon the udders and thighs of livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for flowing milk, especially from sheep, goats, or camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dew, especially dew falling at night on trees and becoming dust-covered like small pieces of clay or mud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantival natural-material use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sebaceous matter, pimples, small pustules, or dirty matter appearing on the nose or face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source associates these formations with heat or scab; the meaning is distinct from ordinary nasal mucus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Whiteness appearing on the nose of a kid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use for an animal’s marking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shame, disgrace, or fear of blame arising from neglecting an inviolable right, duty, or obligation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feeling or consequence connected with failure to honour what is due to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remainder, remnant, remaining portion, or relic.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct vowel pattern and lexical branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A crippling or chronic disease, or an infirmity that prevents a person from going forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantival designation of disabling infirmity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The last remains of something poured or discharged at once.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression for residual liquid or material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who blames, dispraises, or censures much or often.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vice, fault, defect, or similar imperfection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source also records a variant without gemination, belonging to another related lexical form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fatigued horse that has stopped and stands still.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that is blamed or has been made faulty, defective, or vitiated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may describe either exposure to blame or the causing of a defect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man in whom there is no motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of inertness or immobility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of blame or censure, or a blameworthy quality or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may designate either the quality itself or the act for which one is blamed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who is blamed, censured, or dispraised much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive passive description of a person frequently subjected to blame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place held in reverence, respect, or honour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct specialized use applied to a place rather than a person.

cautions: ذِمَّةٌ, the Quranic covenant and protection noun, is distinct in vocalization and meaning from ذَمَّةٌ, the reported term for a scanty or, in one account, plentiful well.
Lane’s entry is organized under the contracted root ذم, while the canonical Quran root is ذمم; the Quran form identities and counts follow the supplied QAC data.
